remarks:
Sitting beautifully on the 9th hole of the Upper Course at Peek’n Peak, this luxury clubhome offers incredible views and true resort-style living with golf and ski-in/ski-out access just steps away.

The spacious living room features large picture windows and a breathtaking two-story stone fireplace, creating a warm and inviting focal point. The gourmet kitchen is designed for cooking and entertaining, complete with granite countertops, a built-in Thermador gas range, and a large island with a breakfast bar.

The primary suite is conveniently located on the first floor and includes direct access to the deck, a large walk-in closet, a luxurious bath with a separate shower, a jetted tub, and a double vanity. 

Upstairs, you’ll find a loft overlooking the main living area, along with two generously sized bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. One bedroom features a private balcony with views of the ski slopes, while the other overlooks the golf course.

The finished lower level includes a recreation room with a pool table, a second fireplace, a bar area, a fourth bedroom, and a full bath—perfect for guests and entertaining.

Relax on the large deck overlooking the golf course or step outside and enjoy everything the resort has to offer, including skiing, tubing, zip line, a ropes course, putt-putt golf, restaurants, an indoor pool, and a day spa, plus so much more. Being sold fully furnished, this is a rare opportunity to own one of the premier clubhomes at the resort.
